label: Check that no existing row breaks the new constraints

precheck.description: no task has only one of archivedAt and archivedById
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."task" WHERE ("archivedAt" IS NULL) <> ("archivedById" IS NULL)) AS "result"

precheck.description: no subtask has a completed flag that disagrees with completedAt
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."task_subtask" WHERE "isCompleted" <> ("completedAt" IS NOT NULL)) AS "result"

precheck.description: no fix attempt has a partly recorded verification
precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."bug_fix_attempt" WHERE ("verificationOutcome" IS NULL) <> ("verifiedById" IS NULL) OR ("verificationOutcome" IS NULL) <> ("verifiedAt" IS NULL)) AS "result"

execute.description: nothing to change before the constraints

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."bug_fix_attempt" ADD CONSTRAINT "bug_fix_attempt_verification_complete_c743879b" CHECK (("verificationOutcome" IS NULL) = ("verifiedById" IS NULL) AND ("verificationOutcome" IS NULL) = ("verifiedAt" IS NULL))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."task" ADD CONSTRAINT "task_archive_pair_dc6ab2b4" CHECK (("archivedAt" IS NULL) = ("archivedById" IS NULL))

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "pg_constraint" AS "c" INNER JOIN "pg_namespace" AS "n" ON "n"."oid" = "c"."connamespace" WHERE ("c"."conname" = $1 AND "n"."nspname" = $2 AND "c"."conrelid" = to_regclass($3))) AS "result"
